node.title: try/catch issue
node.author: perlancar
node.doctext:
I cannot seem to get try/catch to work without Feature::Compat::Try or Syntax::Keyword::Try on perl 5.34.0, any idea what I'm doing wrong? 

#!/usr/bin/env perl

use feature "try";
no experimental "try";

try {
    die "woah";
} catch ($err) {
    print "blah\n";
}

results in "Syntax error at ... line 8, near ) {", while this works: 

use Feature::Compat::Try;

try {
    die "woah";
} catch ($err) {
    print "blah\n";
}

as well as this: 

use Syntax::Keyword::Try;

try {
    die "woah";
} catch ($err) {
    print "blah\n";
}
